description: End-to-end data-governed workflow for proposing, assessing, approving, scheduling, implementing, and auditing network changes in a telco change calendar.

change_id.description: Unique identifier for a change request in the change calendar.

change_window_id.description: Identifier for a specific scheduled implementation window.

risk_assessment_id.description: Identifier for a formal risk assessment record associated with a change.

impact_analysis_id.description: Identifier for a recorded impact analysis.

approval_id.description: Identifier for an approval decision captured in the governance system.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier for a defined rollback plan associated with a change.

network_domain_id.description: Identifier for a logical network domain (e.g., core, RAN, transport, IT).

change_policy_id.description: Identifier of the data governance policy relevant to a given change.

runbook_id.description: Identifier of a standardized change implementation runbook.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: propose_change_request
functions.description: Create a new change request with initial metadata, scope, and governance classification.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the change.

description.description: Detailed description of the change, intent, and context.

requested_by.description: Information about the user or system requesting the change.

network_domains.description: List of network domains impacted by the change.

governance.description: Initial governance classification for the change.

earliest_start.description: Earliest acceptable start time in ISO 8601.

latest_end.description: Latest acceptable end time in ISO 8601.

time_zone.description: Time zone of the proposed timeframe, e.g. 'UTC', 'Europe/Paris'.

related_tickets.description: Related incident, problem, or demand tickets.

attachments.description: Optional attachments containing design docs or plans.

functions.returns: Created change request record including change_id, initial status, and governance profile.

functions.name: list_changes
functions.description: Search and list change requests with filtering by status, timeframe, and governance attributes.

time_range.description: Search by scheduled or actual times.

start.description: Start of time range in ISO 8601.

end.description: End of time range in ISO 8601.

text_query.description: Free text search over title and description.

functions.returns: Paginated list of change requests with summary info and total count.

functions.name: get_change_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details for a specific change, including governance, assessments, and schedule.
functions.returns: Complete change record, including nested governance attributes and any requested related entities.

functions.name: perform_impact_and_risk_assessment
functions.description: Perform structured impact analysis and risk assessment on a proposed change, linking to governance controls.

impact_scope.description: Declared impact scope across services and regions.

functions.returns: Created or updated impact_analysis_id and risk_assessment_id with computed risk score and recommended approval path.

functions.name: validate_change_policy_compliance
functions.description: Validate a change against relevant data governance and change policies, returning compliance findings.

policies.description: List of policy IDs to validate against. If omitted, system determines from governance profile.

include_simulation.description: Whether to run a dry-run simulation of configuration changes when supported.

functions.returns: Compliance validation report including violations, warnings, and overall compliance status linked to change_id and change_policy_id.

functions.name: submit_change_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a change into the approval workflow with a proposed runbook and rollback plan.

runbook.description: Implementation steps or reference to a standardized runbook.

approval_routing.description: Suggested approval routing based on risk and governance.

functions.returns: Updated change record with approval workflow initiated and pending approval tasks, including related approval_id placeholders.

functions.name: record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approval, rejection, or conditional approval decision for a change according to governance rules.

delegated_from_user_id.description: If approval was delegated, original approver's ID.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for conditional approvals.

effective_until.description: For time-bounded approvals, ISO 8601 timestamp until which approval is valid.

functions.returns: Approval record with approval_id and updated change status and governance trail.

functions.name: schedule_change_window
functions.description: Schedule an approved change into a specific implementation window, validating against blackout periods and conflicts.

scheduling_policy.description: Controls for conflict resolution and blackout adherence.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate scheduling to check conflicts and policy adherence.

functions.returns: Scheduled window details with change_window_id, conflict analysis, and updated change status, or conflict errors in dry-run mode.

functions.name: check_change_window_conflicts
functions.description: Check for potential conflicts, overlapping changes, and policy breaches for a candidate change window.

include_details.description: Whether to include detailed overlapping change information.

functions.returns: Conflict analysis report listing overlapping change_window_ids, blackout periods, and policy violations.

functions.name: start_change_implementation
functions.description: Transition a scheduled change into in_progress state, applying governance pre-checks and capturing initial telemetry snapshot.

tool_id.description: If triggered by an automation tool, its identifier.

pre_checks.description: Optional explicit pre-check results if done externally.

telemetry_snapshot_options.description: Options for capturing pre-change telemetry snapshots.

functions.returns: Updated change status to in_progress, reference to captured telemetry artifacts, and any pre-check failures.

functions.name: complete_or_fail_change
functions.description: Mark a change as successfully completed, failed, or partially completed, updating governance outcomes and metrics.

actual_window.description: Actual implementation start and end times.

incident_links.description: Incidents created as a result of change issues.

notes.description: Completion or failure notes by implementer.

functions.returns: Finalized change record with outcome, metrics, and governance audit updates.

functions.name: invoke_change_rollback
functions.description: Trigger rollback for a change, either during implementation or after completion if issues are detected.

notes.description: Additional information about the rollback decision.

functions.returns: Rollback execution request status, updated change status (rolled_back or rollback_in_progress), and references to rollback artifacts.

functions.name: get_change_status_and_audit_trail
functions.description: Retrieve current status, lifecycle history, and audit trail for a change, including governance events.

time_range.description: Optional time range to limit audit events.

functions.returns: Current status, condensed lifecycle state machine, and detailed audit events as per requested include filters.

functions.name: cancel_or_reschedule_change
functions.description: Cancel a pending change or reschedule its window, with governance justification and impact checks.

new_window.description: New window for rescheduling; required if action is reschedule.

governance_override.description: If this action violates policy, record governance override details.

approved_by.description: User ID of governance authority granting override.

functions.returns: Updated change status, optionally new scheduled change_window_id, and governance audit entry for cancel or reschedule action.

functions.name: search_changes
functions.description: Faceted search across change records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for telco_change_governance_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of change records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_changes_by_status
functions.description: List change records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of change records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_change_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single change record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A change record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_changes
functions.description: Submit a batch of change records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_changes
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many change records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_changes
functions.description: Soft-archive change records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_changes
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of change records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_change_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for change lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_change_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created change event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_change_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a change including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_change_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for telco_change_governance_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_change_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a telco_change_governance_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_change_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled telco_change_governance_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_change_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a telco_change_governance_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_change_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a change prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_change_for_approval_2
functions.description: Submit a change for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_change_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending change approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_change
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached change to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_change_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a change.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_change_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a change with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_change_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a change and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_change_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a change (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_change_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for telco_change_governance_flow over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_change_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for telco_change_governance_flow.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_change_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed telco_change_governance_flow behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_change_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active telco_change_governance_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.
